name: UiBufferPoolAcquire
description: returns the current {VB, IB} GpuBuffer pair of the UI buffer ring (pool+390h, refilled from pool+78h, advanced via pair+10h) under the pool+3A8h lock; called once per frame by UiQuadBuild

name: GpuIndexBufferMap
signature: void GpuIndexBufferMap(void* ib, void** out, int mode, u64 off, u32 size)
description: maps the UI index buffer (UiVertexBuilder+380h) into +360h with mode 3; size from ib+48h

name: GpuIndexBufferUnmap
description: unmaps the UI index buffer at the end of UiQuadBuild

name: UiElementResolveWidget
description: returns elem itself when its vfunc+8 is the base stub 1CEA00 and byte +60h is 0, else forwards through vfuncs; used by the icon (type 9) and alpha passes

name: UiDrawLayerPrepareIcons
description: per-frame prepass over UiVertexBuilder::ElementList that handles type-9 (icon) elements only; called right before UiQuadBuild

name: GlyphAtlasResetDirect
description: same body as GlyphAtlasReset but takes the atlas directly; no code or data references (dead); one of only three x=shelfY=pad wipes in .text

name: TextureMapPrepareStaging_NonPersistWipe
description: inlined atlas wipe taken by TextureMapPrepareStaging only when GlyphAtlas::Persistent==0; cave C keeps glyphs only when Persistent!=0

name: TextureMapSubresource
signature: u32 TextureMapSubresource(void* tex, void** out, u32 mip, u32 slice, int mode)
description: maps one texture subresource; slot = tex+B0h+idx*30h; allocates the upload staging (69A720) only if slot+0 is null; returns the pitch

name: UiTextElementCtor
description: installs vtable 38EA3E0 (type-2 text element) and initialises style fields +E0h..+110h

name: UiTextElementVtbl
description: type-2 text element: +8 = 1CC010 (mov eax,2; ret), +68 = UiElemCopyToLocalA 1CB86C (pure: memset + copy into *out); the only whitelisted type-2 +68 in cave R

name: UiIconAdapterVtbl
description: type-9 adapter {vtbl, owner widget}: +8 = 1C23C0 (mov eax,9; ret), +68 = 1C1D38 (forwards to owner vfunc+78), +90 = 1C2390

name: UiWidgetAttachAdapters
signature: void UiWidgetAttachAdapters(void* widget, void* a, void* adapter, void* b)
description: installs UiIconAdapterVtbl into the adapter, links it at widget+2D0h and creates a text element at widget+2D8h

name: UiDrawCtxGetVertexCursor
description: returns [[ctx+8]+358h] (UiVertexBuilder::WriteCursor); vtable getter used by producers

name: UiDrawCtxGetIndexCursor
description: returns [[ctx+8]+360h] (UiVertexBuilder::IndexCursor)

name: UiElementWalk_TextFail
description: text or icon rasterization failed: when rasterizing, clear r14b (196051A = cave C3 site) so the rest of the walk drops text

name: UiQuadBuild_AlphaPassGate
description: if UiSettings::AlphaPassEnable: second pass over the mapped VB writing glyph index floats and scaling vertex alpha (the uncached RMW that cave E removes)

name: GpuBuffer::Size
description: full buffer size; UiQuadBuild maps [0,Size)

name: GpuBuffer::Staging
description: upload staging resource from UploadHeapSuballoc while mapped (buffers that are not CPU-visible)

name: GpuBuffer::StagingOffset
description: suballocation offset of the staging

name: GpuBuffer::CpuVisible
description: nonzero: Map maps the buffer itself instead of a staging copy

name: GpuBuffer::MapMode
description: mode of the current mapping (UiQuadBuild uses 3); 4 = not mapped (set by GpuBufferUnmap); cave E requires 3

name: GpuBuffer::MapOffset
description: offset of the current mapping

name: UiVertexBuilder::ElementList
description: intrusive list of UiQuadNode: first node at +28h, end sentinel at +60h; walked by UiQuadBuild, UiDrawLayerPrepareIcons and UiElementWalk (rdx = builder+18h)

name: UiVertexBuilder::AlphaGroups
description: object with vfunc +18h = group count and +8h(i) = group {+4 = glyph quad count}; drives the alpha pass

name: UiVertexBuilder::DrawCtx
description: {builder, &node+10h} passed in rdx to each producer (vfunc 0 of node+18h)

name: UiVertexBuilder::BufferPool
description: UiBufferPoolAcquire argument

name: UiVertexBuilder::IndexCursor
description: index write cursor (mapped IB), advanced by producers

name: UiVertexBuilder::IndexBuffer
description: GpuBuffer holding the UI indices of the current frame

name: UiVertexBuilder::IndexCapacity
description: index buffer byte capacity checked by producers (1373E8)

name: UiVertexBuilder::IndexBytesCommitted
description: index bytes written this frame; zeroed together with BytesCommitted by the qword store at 1CD6B9

name: UiQuadNode::Next
description: next node (end = builder+60h)

name: UiQuadNode::Element
description: UI element (vfunc +8 type, +40 alpha, +68 copy style to local, +70/+78 text)

name: UiQuadNode::Producer
description: vertex producer object; vfunc 0 returns false on failure (exit 19602DC)

name: UiQuadNode::VertexCount
description: vertices this node emitted (x 2Ch bytes); the alpha pass skips by it

name: UiSettings::AlphaPassEnable
description: gates the vertex-alpha second pass in UiQuadBuild

name: UiSettings::VertexStride
description: UI vertex stride in bytes (2Ch); producers reserve stride*4 per quad

name: GlyphAtlas::CodeTablePtr
description: code -> node index (points at +B0h)

name: GlyphAtlas::NodesPtr
description: GlyphNode array (points at +200B0h)

name: GlyphAtlas::GlyphPage
description: current font page: u16 index table + 12-byte glyph records at +20000h

name: GlyphAtlas::LookupKey
description: code | page<<16 | palette<<24 of the glyph being looked up

name: GlyphAtlas::Pitch
description: staging row pitch returned by TextureMapSubresource

name: GlyphAtlas::PixelPtr
description: mapped staging pixels; set by TextureMapPrepareStaging, cleared by GlyphAtlasUpload

name: GlyphNode::Uv
description: u0 v0 u1 v1 of the glyph rect

name: GlyphNode::ChildA
description: BST link by key

name: GlyphNode::ChildB
description: BST link by key

name: GlyphNode::Key
description: code | page<<16 | palette<<24

name: Texture::Subresources
description: per-subresource slots {+0 upload staging, +10h readback staging, +20h map mode (4 = unmapped), +24h pitch, +28h size}; the upload staging is kept when PersistentStaging

name: TextRenderer::AtlasMgr
description: glyph atlas manager: +B8h atlas ref, +C0h, +C8h mapped flag (rasterization allowed only while set)

name: TextRenderer::AtlasMapped
description: set by UiAtlasMap every frame
